watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。

Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.

guides.title: 半導體製程工藝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Semiconductor Fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立 CMOS 剖面層序」建立判讀邊界。閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 對應操作：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Build the CMOS cross-section stack to define the interpretation boundary. A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. Corresponding operation: Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立 CMOS 剖面層序：保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
觀察站 2｜延伸接面剖面建模：觀察與驗證重點：接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
觀察站 3｜良品晶圓製造交接：觀察與驗證重點：接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build the CMOS cross-section stack: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.

Observation station 2 | Model extension-junction profiles: Observation and validation target: both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.

Observation station 3 | Handoff qualified wafers: Observation and validation target: the receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「延伸接面剖面建模」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「良品晶圓製造交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model extension-junction profiles: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Handoff qualified wafers to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
診斷提醒：只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
Diagnostic consideration: peak concentration alone hides deep tails. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.

guides.title: 晶圓研磨與拋光：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer lapping and polishing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界」建立判讀邊界。裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP to define the interpretation boundary. Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界：觀察「厚度達標」與「保留薄膜達標」是否指向不同的量測。
觀察站 2｜分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動：比較材料容易反應但接觸不良，以及接觸充分但漿料狀態不合適的兩種情境。
觀察站 3｜整合晶圓放行與異常處置：確認「尚無證據」沒有被寫成「已證明合格」，不同量測仍保留其基準。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP: Notice whether target wafer thickness and target remaining film require different measurements.
Observation station 2 | Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: Compare a reactive surface with poor contact against good contact with unsuitable slurry condition.
Observation station 3 | Integrate wafer release and disposition: Ensure missing evidence is not recorded as demonstrated compliance and each measurement retains its reference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合晶圓放行與異常處置」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integrate wafer release and disposition to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把金屬 CMP 的選擇性直接當成裸矽拋光規格，先退回材料清單重新界定。
把所有變化歸因於轉速會忽略墊面或漿料；重新建立一因一變的比較。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If metal-CMP selectivity is treated as a bare-silicon specification, revisit the material inventory.
Attributing every change to speed ignores the pad or slurry; restore a one-factor comparison.

guides.title: 高數值孔徑 EUV 成像：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: High-numerical-aperture EUV imaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分開節點名稱與實際線寬」建立判讀邊界。微影解析度與半導體節點命名描述不同層面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate node labels from feature dimensions to define the interpretation boundary. Lithographic resolution and node naming describe different aspects. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分開節點名稱與實際線寬：節點名稱不能直接代入每個幾何尺寸。
觀察站 2｜推演晶圓與光罩同步掃描：平台各自位置正確仍須保持相對同步。
觀察站 3｜完成成像整合交付：漂亮影像不能取代統計與流程相容證據。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate node labels from feature dimensions: A node label is not every physical dimension.
Observation station 2 | Model synchronized wafer and mask scanning: Individually correct positions still require relative synchronization.
Observation station 3 | Complete the imaging-integration dossier: Attractive images cannot replace statistics and integration evidence.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「推演晶圓與光罩同步掃描」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成成像整合交付」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model synchronized wafer and mask scanning: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the imaging-integration dossier to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把「2 nm」當成所有線寬，退回欄位定義。
若兩平台使用相同位移卻倍率不同，重算對應關係。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Revisit definitions if a 2 nm label is treated as every linewidth.
Recalculate mapping if both stages move equally despite demagnification.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon wafer wire sawing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識晶向」建立判讀邊界。晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify crystal orientation to define the interpretation boundary. Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識晶向：檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜總厚度變異：檢查結果是否能支持「TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜切片批次放行：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度、損傷、邊緣與追溯證據須同時交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify crystal orientation: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure total thickness variation: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release a slicing lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「總厚度變異」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「切片批次放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure total thickness variation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release a slicing lot to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「總厚度變異」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure total thickness variation and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 絕緣層上覆矽晶圓製造：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon-on-insulator wafer fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨認三層結構」建立判讀邊界。頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify the three-layer stack to define the interpretation boundary. Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨認三層結構：檢查結果是否能支持「頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜頂矽厚度圖：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度非均勻可能轉成元件臨界電壓變異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜SOI 放行矩陣：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、薄層均勻、鍵合與熱管理需共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify the three-layer stack: Check whether the evidence supports: Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Map top-silicon thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness nonuniformity can translate into threshold-voltage variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the SOI stack: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation, layer uniformity, bonding and thermal behavior require joint review. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「頂矽厚度圖」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「SOI 放行矩陣」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map top-silicon thickness: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the SOI stack to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨認三層結構」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「頂矽厚度圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify the three-layer stack and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map top-silicon thickness and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶圓廠微污染控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Microcontamination control in fabs: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立污染源地圖」建立判讀邊界。人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Map contamination sources to define the interpretation boundary. People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立污染源地圖：檢查結果是否能支持「人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜容器浸出物：檢查結果是否能支持「化學液潔淨度會受包材與接觸時間影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜污染控制報告：檢查結果是否能支持「來源、傳輸、沉積與電性後果應分層呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Map contamination sources: Check whether the evidence supports: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Audit container extractables: Check whether the evidence supports: Chemical purity depends on packaging and contact duration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Compile the control dossier: Check whether the evidence supports: Report source, transport, deposition and electrical consequence separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「容器浸出物」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「污染控制報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Audit container extractables: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Compile the control dossier to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「建立污染源地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「容器浸出物」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map contamination sources and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for audit container extractables and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate growth and deposition to define the interpretation boundary. Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. procedure: 觀察站 1｜分辨成長與沉積：檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate growth and deposition: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Interpret ellipsometric thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Optical thickness extraction requires index and stack assumptions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the gate oxide: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs thickness mapping, interface quality, leakage and reliability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

guides.concept: 先用「物理厚度與 EOT」建立判讀邊界。較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate thickness and EOT to define the interpretation boundary. Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜物理厚度與 EOT：檢查結果是否能支持「較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜深槽反應物耗盡：檢查結果是否能支持「入口飽和不代表高深寬比底部已飽和。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜高介電層放行：檢查結果是否能支持「EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate thickness and EOT: Check whether the evidence supports: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Assess feature-scale depletion: Check whether the evidence supports: Entrance saturation does not prove bottom saturation in deep features. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the high-k layer: Check whether the evidence supports: Review EOT, leakage, traps and 3D coverage jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「深槽反應物耗盡」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「高介電層放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Assess feature-scale depletion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the high-k layer to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「物理厚度與 EOT」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「深槽反應物耗盡」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate thickness and eot and add discriminating evidence.

guides.titleEn: Rapid thermal annealing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「活化與擴散」建立判讀邊界。活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate activation and diffusion: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare sheet resistance: Check whether the evidence supports: Reduced sheet resistance should be assessed with junction depth. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the annealing window: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation, diffusion, leakage and structural damage must all meet criteria. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

以「退火窗口放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare sheet resistance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the annealing window to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「活化與擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「片電阻前後」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

guides.title: 淺溝槽隔離製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Shallow-trench isolation fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「主動區邊界」建立判讀邊界。隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw active-area boundaries to define the interpretation boundary. Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜主動區邊界：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜底部與側壁成長：檢查結果是否能支持「不均勻成長可能造成入口先封閉。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜STI 整合放行：檢查結果是否能支持「填充、平坦、漏電與通道應力需共同符合要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw active-area boundaries: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare bottom and sidewall growth: Check whether the evidence supports: Uneven growth can close the opening prematurely. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept STI integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Fill, planarity, leakage and channel stress require joint acceptance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「底部與側壁成長」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「STI 整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare bottom and sidewall growth: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept STI integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「主動區邊界」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「底部與側壁成長」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw active-area boundaries and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare bottom and sidewall growth and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 應變矽通道整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Strained-silicon channel integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「應力與應變」建立判讀邊界。應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate stress and strain to define the interpretation boundary. Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜應力與應變：檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜拉曼位移：檢查結果是否能支持「峰位變化也需排除溫度及成分影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜應變整合結論：檢查結果是否能支持「需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate stress and strain: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Interpret Raman shifts: Check whether the evidence supports: Peak shifts require separating temperature and composition effects. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review strain integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「拉曼位移」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「應變整合結論」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interpret Raman shifts: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review strain integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「拉曼位移」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret raman shifts and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「互補反相器」建立判讀邊界。NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a complementary inverter to define the interpretation boundary. NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜互補反相器：檢查結果是否能支持「NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

觀察站 3｜整合流程審查：檢查結果是否能支持「步驟可單獨合格仍可能在相互作用後失敗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a complementary inverter: Check whether the evidence supports: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Assess silicide formation: Check whether the evidence supports: Conductive contact reactions also consume surface silicon. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review the integrated flow: Check whether the evidence supports: Individually acceptable steps can fail through integration interactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「矽化物形成」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合流程審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Assess silicide formation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review the integrated flow to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「矽化物形成」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess silicide formation and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Complementary FET research process flows: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「垂直互補配置」建立判讀邊界。CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw vertical complementary stacking to define the interpretation boundary. CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜垂直互補配置：檢查結果是否能支持「CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜前側底層接觸：檢查結果是否能支持「底層接觸需穿越或繞過上層結構。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜CFET 證據地圖：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw vertical complementary stacking: Check whether the evidence supports: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Trace frontside bottom contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Bottom contacts from the front must pass or bypass upper structures. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Assemble a CFET evidence map: Check whether the evidence supports: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「前側底層接觸」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「CFET 證據地圖」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace frontside bottom contacts: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assemble a CFET evidence map to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「垂直互補配置」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「前側底層接觸」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw vertical complementary stacking and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace frontside bottom contacts and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate inner and outer spacers: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare low-k materials: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the spacer module: Check whether the evidence supports: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「低介電材料」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「內外間隔差別」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate inner and outer spacers and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 深紫外光阻塗佈：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Deep-ultraviolet photoresist coating: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「曝光波長匹配」建立判讀邊界。DUV 光阻須以相應波長資料選擇，不能以外觀判斷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Match exposure wavelength to define the interpretation boundary. DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜曝光波長匹配：檢查結果是否能支持「DUV 光阻須以相應波長資料選擇，不能以外觀判斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜邊珠去除：檢查結果是否能支持「去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜DUV 塗佈交接：檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚、邊緣、背面及缺陷證據須一起交給曝光端。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Match exposure wavelength: Check whether the evidence supports: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Define edge-bead removal evidence: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the DUV coating: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness, edge, backside and defect evidence must accompany exposure handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「邊珠去除」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「DUV 塗佈交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Define edge-bead removal evidence: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the DUV coating to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「曝光波長匹配」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「邊珠去除」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for match exposure wavelength and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define edge-bead removal evidence and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 極紫外金屬氧化物光阻研究：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: EUV metal-oxide resist research: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈」建立判讀邊界。吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Trace photons to changed solubility to define the interpretation boundary. Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈：吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜設計劑量與焦距的二維矩陣：最佳單點不等於具有寬製程窗口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提出包含化學、圖形與電性的材料審查：材料選擇應由多層證據支持。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Trace photons to changed solubility: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Design a dose–focus matrix: An optimum point is not a broad process window. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review chemistry, pattern and electrical evidence together: Material selection needs multiple levels of evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設計劑量與焦距的二維矩陣」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提出包含化學、圖形與電性的材料審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Design a dose–focus matrix: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review chemistry, pattern and electrical evidence together to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「只看平均線寬即可排除罕見缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Mean linewidth alone rules out rare defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 相位移光罩工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Phase-shift mask engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光」建立判讀邊界。相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane to define the interpretation boundary. Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光：相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜對密集與孤立線比較成像對比：一種相位配置不會同等改善所有圖形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查：設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane: Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: One phase scheme does not improve every pattern equally. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review phase assignment and imaging window together: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「對密集與孤立線比較成像對比」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review phase assignment and imaging window together to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「只需把兩束光強相加。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「最佳焦點改善代表所有焦距都改善。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Simply add the two intensities.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Better best-focus imaging proves improvement at every focus.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Convert layout into writable primitives to define the interpretation boundary. Conversion must preserve scale and topology. procedure: 觀察站 1｜把設計版圖轉成可寫入圖元：資料轉換須保留尺度與拓樸。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Convert layout into writable primitives: Conversion must preserve scale and topology. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver data, dose and overlay records: Reproducing direct writing needs complete design and history. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

guides.title: 微影隨機缺陷分析：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Lithographic stochastic-defect analysis: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「區分線邊粗糙度與離散失敗事件」建立判讀邊界。連續變異與罕見事件需要不同指標。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish line-edge roughness from discrete failures to define the interpretation boundary. Continuous variation and rare failures need different metrics. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜區分線邊粗糙度與離散失敗事件：連續變異與罕見事件需要不同指標。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜以相同線寬比較不同劑量條件：幾何改變會混淆純劑量效應。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付帶信賴區間與限制的缺陷報告：明確分母與不確定度才使結果可比較。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish line-edge roughness from discrete failures: Continuous variation and rare failures need different metrics. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Compare doses at matched linewidth: Geometry changes confound dose-only effects. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a defect report with confidence intervals and limits: Explicit denominators and uncertainty enable comparison. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「以相同線寬比較不同劑量條件」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付帶信賴區間與限制的缺陷報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare doses at matched linewidth: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a defect report with confidence intervals and limits to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「零觀察缺陷就表示缺陷率為零。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「所有缺陷都只由光子數決定。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Zero observed defects means zero defect probability.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Photon count alone determines every defect.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 電漿端點偵測：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Plasma endpoint detection: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「把 OES 發光峰對應至可能物種」建立判讀邊界。峰值指認需排除重疊與背景。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Associate OES peaks with candidate species to define the interpretation boundary. Peak assignments need overlap and background checks. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜把 OES 發光峰對應至可能物種：峰值指認需排除重疊與背景。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜設計持續時間確認以避免誤觸發：確認時間也增加停止延遲。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付具回溯資料的端點控制計畫：每次停止應能對應訊號與膜厚證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Associate OES peaks with candidate species: Peak assignments need overlap and background checks. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Require persistence to reduce false triggers: Persistence confirmation adds stop delay. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver an endpoint plan with traceable data: Each stop should link to signal and thickness evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設計持續時間確認以避免誤觸發」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付具回溯資料的端點控制計畫」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Require persistence to reduce false triggers: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver an endpoint plan with traceable data to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「所有亮度變化都等於材料已蝕刻完。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「偵測到端點後所有反應立即停止。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Every brightness change means etching is complete.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "All reactions stop instantly when endpoint is detected.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 金屬有機化學氣相沉積：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Metal-organic chemical vapor deposition: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出金屬有機源到晶體薄膜的路徑」建立判讀邊界。氣相分解與表面反應不是同一階段。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Trace metal-organic sources into crystalline films to define the interpretation boundary. Gas decomposition and surface reaction are different stages. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出金屬有機源到晶體薄膜的路徑：氣相分解與表面反應不是同一階段。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用 XRD 概念分開晶格常數與應變：峰位改變可能有多種來源。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付反應器、結構與性能的證據鏈：可重現成長需要完整條件與量測範圍。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Trace metal-organic sources into crystalline films: Gas decomposition and surface reaction are different stages. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Use XRD concepts to distinguish lattice parameter and strain: Peak shifts can have multiple origins. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver reactor, structure and performance evidence: Reproducible growth needs complete conditions and measurement scope. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用 XRD 概念分開晶格常數與應變」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付反應器、結構與性能的證據鏈」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Use XRD concepts to distinguish lattice parameter and strain: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver reactor, structure and performance evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「氣相混合均勻就能保證晶體完全無缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「發光強度相同就代表晶體品質完全相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Uniform gas mixing guarantees defect-free crystals.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Equal emission intensity proves identical crystal quality.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Sputtered thin-film processing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出離子撞擊靶材與原子逸出」建立判讀邊界。濺鍍產率依入射與材料條件改變。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Sketch ion impact and target-atom ejection to define the interpretation boundary. Sputter yield depends on incidence and material conditions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出離子撞擊靶材與原子逸出：濺鍍產率依入射與材料條件改變。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜量測厚度地圖並計算均勻性：均勻性公式與取樣範圍需明示。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付厚度、介面、電性與覆蓋證據：薄膜用途決定驗收指標組合。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Sketch ion impact and target-atom ejection: Sputter yield depends on incidence and material conditions. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Map thickness and calculate uniformity: Uniformity definition and sampling range must be stated. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver thickness, interface, electrical and coverage evidence: Film application determines the acceptance metrics. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測厚度地圖並計算均勻性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付厚度、介面、電性與覆蓋證據」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map thickness and calculate uniformity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver thickness, interface, electrical and coverage evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「濺鍍就是把靶材煮沸。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「較厚薄膜一定較低應力。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Sputtering simply boils the target.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a contact from device to first metal to define the interpretation boundary. A vertical contact includes multiple material interfaces. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出元件到第一層金屬的接點：垂直接點包含多個材料介面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

Observation station 3 | Review fill, planarization and contact resistance: Plug validation must cover geometry and interfaces. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。

guides.title: 銅雙鑲嵌互連：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Copper dual-damascene interconnects: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」建立判讀邊界。垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a via and trench between metal levels to define the interpretation boundary. Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充：超共形填充可避免過早封口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查：局部製程合格仍需跨層功能驗證。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a via and trench between metal levels: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: Superconformal fill can avoid premature closure. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a two-level RC and failure review: Local process acceptance still needs cross-layer functional validation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a two-level RC and failure review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「表面平坦可排除內部空洞。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A planar surface rules out internal voids.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 阻障層與種子層沉積：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Barrier and seed-layer deposition: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出介電層、阻障、種子與銅主體」建立判讀邊界。不同層負責不同物理功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw dielectric, barrier, seed and bulk copper to define the interpretation boundary. Different layers serve different physical functions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出介電層、阻障、種子與銅主體：不同層負責不同物理功能。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜以片電阻地圖檢查種子連續性：低平均電阻仍可能伴隨局部斷點。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付覆蓋、導通、擴散與附著評審：阻障種子整合需要四類證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw dielectric, barrier, seed and bulk copper: Different layers serve different physical functions. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Map sheet resistance to assess seed continuity: Low mean resistance can coexist with local discontinuities. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review coverage, continuity, diffusion and adhesion: Barrier–seed integration needs four classes of evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

以「交付覆蓋、導通、擴散與附著評審」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map sheet resistance to assess seed continuity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review coverage, continuity, diffusion and adhesion to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「有種子層就不需要任何擴散阻障。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「種子表面氧化不會影響電鍍。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "A seed layer eliminates all need for a diffusion barrier.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

觀察站 3｜可靠度報告：故障判讀與驗證：單一最佳估計不足以表達壽命可信度；信賴區間應說明樣本與假設。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Field and thickness: construct and analyze: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ; Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity.
Observation station 2 | Area scaling: construct and analyze: Area scaling requires the same defect population and mechanism; Defect clustering breaks independent-area assumptions.
Observation station 3 | Reliability report: diagnose and verify: One best estimate does not express lifetime confidence; Confidence intervals need sample and assumption context.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「面積縮放：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可靠度報告：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Area scaling: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Reliability report: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「用不同材料電容驗證純面積效應」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Using different materials to establish a pure area effect", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.concept: 先用「電荷儲存層：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電荷儲存層：建立模型：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同；局域捕捉電荷可具有不同能階。
觀察站 2｜阻擋層：建立模型：阻擋層服務的界面不同於穿隧層；閘極注入可和通道注入競爭。
觀察站 3｜記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證：平均記憶窗不能代表最弱單元裕量；錯誤更正能力不能取代元件量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates; Localized trapped charges occupy different energies.
Observation station 2 | Blocking layer: construct and analyze: The blocking layer serves a different interface from the tunnel layer; Gate injection can compete with channel injection.
Observation station 3 | Memory-window acceptance: diagnose and verify: Mean window does not represent weakest-cell margin; Error correction does not replace device measurements.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「阻擋層：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Blocking layer: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Memory-window acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把捕捉層畫成等電位金屬浮閘」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「互換兩層而假定能帶條件不變」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Drawing a trap layer as an equipotential metallic floating gate", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Swapping the layers while assuming unchanged bands", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 相變化記憶體製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Phase-change memory fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「相態與電阻：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Phase and resistance: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜相態與電阻：建立模型：電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。
觀察站 2｜受限相變體積：建立模型：外圍材料未必每次都完成相變；有效熱區可小於電極覆蓋面積。
觀察站 3｜陣列耐久度：故障判讀與驗證：單元展示和整陣列可靠度證據不同；耐久與保持通常需不同測試序列。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Phase and resistance: construct and analyze: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
Observation station 2 | Confined active volume: construct and analyze: Surrounding material need not transform each cycle; Active thermal volume can be smaller than electrode area.
Observation station 3 | Array endurance: diagnose and verify: Single-cell demonstrations and array reliability are different evidence; Endurance and retention need different test sequences.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「受限相變體積：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「陣列耐久度：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Confined active volume: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Array endurance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「把全部沉積材料當成每次都重熔」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming all deposited material remelts each cycle", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「MTJ 分層：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with MTJ stack: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.

觀察站 2｜障壁均勻度：建立模型：局部薄點可能支配穿隧與崩潰；障壁缺口可形成平行漏電路徑。
觀察站 3｜記憶體用途：故障判讀與驗證：不同用途下最佳磁記憶體架構可不同；快取保持需求可不同於長期儲存。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | MTJ stack: construct and analyze: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
Observation station 2 | Barrier uniformity: construct and analyze: Thin spots can dominate tunneling and breakdown; Barrier defects can add parallel leakage.
Observation station 3 | Memory application: diagnose and verify: The best magnetic-memory architecture depends on use; Cache retention needs differ from archival storage.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Barrier uniformity: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Memory application: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「平均厚度相同便推定障壁電性等效」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming equal average thickness means equivalent electrical barriers", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.concept: 先用「垂直元件路徑：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Vertical device path: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Vertical MOSFET resistance has multiple regional contributions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜垂直元件路徑：建立模型：垂直 MOSFET 的電阻由多區域組成；封裝引線也貢獻量到的電阻。
觀察站 2｜接觸電阻：建立模型：二端電阻含接觸和通道貢獻；接觸模型需要確認線性工作範圍。
觀察站 3｜晶片到模組：故障判讀與驗證：封裝及驅動條件會改變元件實際應力；熱循環也會改變封裝界面。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Vertical device path: construct and analyze: Vertical MOSFET resistance has multiple regional contributions; Package leads contribute measured resistance.
Observation station 2 | Contact resistance: construct and analyze: Two-terminal resistance includes contact and channel terms; Contact models need verified linear ranges.
Observation station 3 | Die-to-module validation: diagnose and verify: Package and drive conditions alter actual device stress; Thermal cycling can alter package interfaces.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸電阻：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「晶片到模組：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Contact resistance: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Die-to-module validation: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把全部導通電阻都歸給通道」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「把二端總電阻直接當接觸電阻」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Attributing all on-resistance to the channel", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Calling total two-terminal resistance contact resistance", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Direct bandgap: construct and analyze: Not all current becomes emitted light; Nonradiative recombination produces heat.
Observation station 2 | Multiple quantum wells: construct and analyze: Multiple wells do not imply equal injection per well; Inter-well transport depends on barriers and capture.
Observation station 3 | Epitaxy acceptance: diagnose and verify: Optical excitation and electrical injection provide different evidence; EL and PL have different excitation profiles.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

guides.concept: 先用「HBT 與 pHEMT：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：同為 GaAs RF 元件不代表相同控制機制。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with HBT versus pHEMT: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: GaAs RF devices need not share a control mechanism. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜HBT 與 pHEMT：建立模型：同為 GaAs RF 元件不代表相同控制機制；HBT 與 HEMT 的輸入阻抗不同。
觀察站 2｜隔離與漏電：建立模型：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
觀察站 3｜技術選擇：故障判讀與驗證：最佳製程取決於系統角色；匹配網路損耗會改變系統最佳選擇。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | HBT versus pHEMT: construct and analyze: GaAs RF devices need not share a control mechanism; HBT and HEMT input impedances differ.
Observation station 2 | Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.
Observation station 3 | Technology selection: diagnose and verify: The preferred process depends on system role; Matching-network losses change system-level choices.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「隔離與漏電：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「技術選擇：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Technology selection: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「用同一閘極模型描述 HBT 基極」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Describing an HBT base with an unchanged gate model", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「單層與晶粒：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜單層與晶粒：建立模型：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。
觀察站 2｜接觸抽取：建立模型：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
觀察站 3｜晶圓可製造性：故障判讀與驗證：高覆蓋率不等於高功能良率；形貌良率不涵蓋接觸及介電缺陷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects; Grain orientation changes boundary character.
Observation station 2 | Contact extraction: construct and analyze: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.
Observation station 3 | Wafer manufacturability: diagnose and verify: High coverage yield is not high functional yield; Morphology yield omits contact and dielectric failures.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸抽取：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「晶圓可製造性：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Contact extraction: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Wafer manufacturability: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜工廠與供應鏈：建立模型：GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方；廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe; Public fab locations do not expose tool positions.

Observation station 3 | Public-case review: diagnose and verify: Public performance does not reveal proprietary control recipes; Separate announced targets from measured achievements.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分辨光與電介面」建立判讀邊界。光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish optical and electrical interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分辨光與電介面：光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 在系統圖區分光路、電路與控制路徑。
觀察站 2｜分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗：假設參考功率 1.00 mW，輸出 0.25 mW，IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB；此值仍包含未去嵌耦合器。
觀察站 3｜交付可重現 CPO 設計審查：最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish optical and electrical interfaces: Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Separate optical, electrical and control paths in the system diagram.
Observation station 2 | Separate reference planes and insertion loss: With hypothetical reference 1.00 mW and output 0.25 mW, IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB; unremoved coupler loss remains included.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a reproducible CPO review: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重現 CPO 設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate reference planes and insertion loss: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a reproducible CPO review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 把熱調諧控制線當成高速資料線，會混淆頻寬需求。
重新插拔參考線後未重校正，會把治具漂移當元件變化。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Treating a thermal-control line as the high-speed data path confuses bandwidth requirements.
Reconnecting without rereferencing makes fixture drift appear to be device change.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
