guides.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「界定混合接合的兩種功能」建立判讀邊界。混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define the two functions of hybrid bonding to define the interpretation boundary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜界定混合接合的兩種功能：整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
觀察站 2｜區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲：教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。
觀察站 3｜交付 W2W 資格證據封包：官方 2026 年 200 nm W2W 研究展示是有日期和試片範圍的里程碑；本課 1 µm 方墊算例不能被標為該流程複製。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define the two functions of hybrid bonding: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.

Observation station 2 | Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a W2W qualification-evidence package: The official 2026 200 nm W2W study is a dated test-vehicle milestone; this course's 1 µm square-pad examples are not reproductions of that flow.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付 W2W 資格證據封包」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a W2W qualification-evidence package to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
小區域很平不代表整片能無缺陷接觸。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.
A locally smooth area does not guarantee defect-free whole-wafer contact.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Copper-pillar microbump fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「焊墊與凸塊座標」建立判讀邊界。焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Pad and bump coordinates to define the interpretation boundary. Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜焊墊與凸塊座標：疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜阻障與焊料帽：量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜組裝交接與抽樣：交付可追溯晶粒地圖及不確定度，挑選邊緣條件樣本進行接合驗證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Pad and bump coordinates: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Bond-stack cross-section to define the interpretation boundary. Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.

觀察站 3｜接合窗口的轉移限制：列變更矩陣與保留條件，至少含幾何、電性、界面和熱循環證據。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Bond-stack cross-section: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Oxide and wetting evidence: Compare bond faces, open-site maps and good controls rather than one low-magnification section. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Limits of process-window transfer: Document changes and holds using geometric, electrical, interface and thermal-cycle evidence. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「氧化與潤濕證據」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「接合窗口的轉移限制」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Oxide and wetting evidence: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Limits of process-window transfer to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：高電阻一律表示加熱不足。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Attributing every high resistance to insufficient heating. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.concept: 先用「銅與介電界面區分」建立判讀邊界。直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜銅與介電界面區分：畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜晶粒取向與界面遷移：用多位置截面或取向分析對照電性，標注取樣偏差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜接合界面交接：建立批次證據包並列出未覆蓋的面積或應力範圍。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Grain orientation and interface migration: Compare multisite sections or orientation analysis with electrical data and note sampling bias. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Interface qualification handoff: Assemble lot evidence and declare untested area or stress ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「晶粒取向與界面遷移」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「接合界面交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Grain orientation and interface migration: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Interface qualification handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：一張無接縫截面足以代表整片界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using one seam-free section to certify the whole interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 扇出型面板級封裝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Fan-out panel-level packaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「格式與設備邊界」建立判讀邊界。面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Format and tool boundaries to define the interpretation boundary. Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜格式與設備邊界：建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜曝光拼接：跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜規模化經濟：比較每良品成本及尾端風險。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Format and tool boundaries: List effective process areas at every station. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Exposure stitching: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Scale economics: Compare cost per good unit and tail risks. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「曝光拼接」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「規模化經濟」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Exposure stitching: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scale economics to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 系統級封裝異質整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: System-in-package heterogeneous integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「功能需求樹」建立判讀邊界。系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Functional requirement tree to define the interpretation boundary. System performance must become measurable module interfaces. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜功能需求樹：把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜射頻隔離：畫有意信號與非預期耦合路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜系統接受測試：提交代表和邊界情境驗證矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Functional requirement tree: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | RF isolation: Draw desired signals and unintended coupling. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | System acceptance: Submit representative and boundary-scenario matrices. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「射頻隔離」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「系統接受測試」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for RF isolation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：金屬罩能消除全部電源耦合。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming a shield eliminates all power coupling. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 矽穿孔蝕刻與絕緣：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via etching and insulation: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「Via-first/middle/last」建立判讀邊界。形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Via-first/middle/last to define the interpretation boundary. Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜Via-first/middle/last：畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜清潔與表面：配對清潔見證與漏電分布。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜金屬化交接：提交孔形與漏電共同地圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Via-first/middle/last: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Cleaning and surface: Pair cleaning witnesses and leakage distributions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Metallization handoff: Deliver paired geometry/leakage maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「清潔與表面」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「金屬化交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Cleaning and surface: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Metallization handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：孔洞幾何合格即不需表面驗證。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Giving every TSV the same thermal budget. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Skipping surface qualification after geometry passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 矽穿孔金屬填充：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via metal filling: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「導體選擇」建立判讀邊界。Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Conductor selection to define the interpretation boundary. Cu and W differ in resistivity, deposition and thermal mismatch. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜導體選擇：比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜傳質與圖形：按密度區比較空洞與厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜放行與露出：交付深度對位圖與缺陷界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Conductor selection: Compare resistance and stress objectives. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Transport and pattern: Compare voids/thickness by density region. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Release to reveal: Deliver depth-registered maps and defect bounds. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「傳質與圖形」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「放行與露出」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transport and pattern: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release to reveal to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：最低電阻材料必是每種 TSV 最佳選擇。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：流場均勻就代表所有孔內傳質相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming lowest resistivity is always best. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Equating uniform bulk flow with equal in-via transport. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 矽穿孔背面露出：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via backside reveal: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「深度座標」建立判讀邊界。TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Depth coordinates to define the interpretation boundary. TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜深度座標：統一圖面和量測零點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜終點感測：以局部量測核對全域終點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜露出驗收：建立逐區幾何電性對照。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Depth coordinates: Unify design and metrology zero references. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Endpoint sensing: Check global endpoints against local measurements. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Reveal acceptance: Build regional geometry/electrical comparisons. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「終點感測」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「露出驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Endpoint sensing: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Reveal acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：全域終點一出現即可停止且全部完成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Through-glass-via fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「玻璃組成」建立判讀邊界。玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Glass composition to define the interpretation boundary. CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜玻璃組成：指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜種子覆蓋：檢查入口、中央和出口截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜整合放行：保存孔群位置和失效類型。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Glass composition: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Seed coverage: Inspect entrance, middle and exit sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Integration release: Retain array location and failure class. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「種子覆蓋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Seed coverage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration release to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：雙面表面有種子即可證明孔壁相連。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all glass as one material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring wall continuity from seeded faces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 矽中介層佈線：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon-interposer routing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「被動與主動中介層」建立判讀邊界。是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Passive and active interposers to define the interpretation boundary. Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜被動與主動中介層：標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜TSV 分配：建立 TSV 網路與電流密度圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜共同簽核：檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Passive and active interposers: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | TSV allocation: Build TSV net and current-density maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Co-signoff: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「TSV 分配」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「共同簽核」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for TSV allocation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Co-signoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：地 TSV 可只按剩餘空間放置。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Placing ground TSVs only in leftover space. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 有機中介層製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Organic-interposer fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「劃分晶粒與中介層」建立判讀邊界。中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Partition dies and interposer to define the interpretation boundary. An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜劃分晶粒與中介層：觀察焦點：畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜分析順應性：觀察焦點：比較剛性與順應中介層的受力路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成中介層交接：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列明不能由公開架構圖推定的製造參數。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Partition dies and interposer: Observation focus: Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Analyze compliance: Observation focus: Compare load paths in rigid and compliant interposers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete interposer handoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List manufacturing parameters not inferable from public architecture diagrams. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分析順應性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成中介層交接：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Analyze compliance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete interposer handoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「劃分晶粒與中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「分析順應性」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到聚合物可分散某些應力，但也帶來蠕變和翹曲變化。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for partition dies and interposer actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.

Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for analyze compliance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Polymers redistribute some stress but introduce creep and warpage variation.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define core and build-up to define the interpretation boundary. The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義核心與增層：觀察焦點：將核心和增層分色標示。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜估算熱失配：觀察焦點：重算 12 μm 差位移並說明不是裂紋張開量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜評估研究成熟度：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：用公開證據標註已證明與仍待證明事項。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define core and build-up: Observation focus: Color core and build-up separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Estimate thermal mismatch: Observation focus: Recalculate 12 μm mismatch and explain why it is not crack opening. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Label demonstrated and unresolved claims from public evidence. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「估算熱失配」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Estimate thermal mismatch: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「定義核心與增層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「估算熱失配」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到玻璃和銅膨脹不同會在孔口及端面形成局部負荷。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for define core and build-up actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing.

Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for estimate thermal mismatch actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Glass-copper mismatch loads via entrances and ends locally.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify ABF function to define the interpretation boundary. ABF provides interlayer insulation and a routing foundation; copper conducts. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識 ABF 功能：觀察焦點：畫銅線與介電層而不混為一層。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜控制種子與電鍍：觀察焦點：用孔口、孔中及孔底三處驗證。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付基板製造證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列出因材料換版必須重驗的項目。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

Observation station 2 | Control seed and plating: Observation focus: Check via entrance, middle and bottom. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver substrate evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List checks required after a material revision. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「控制種子與電鍍」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付基板製造證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Control seed and plating: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver substrate evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：ABF 是導電銅箔材料。本步先檢查「辨識 ABF 功能」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到ABF 提供層間絕緣和細線基底，銅才承擔主要導電。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：ABF 是導電銅箔材料。本步先檢查「控制種子與電鍍」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到種子連續性及局部電流分布決定孔壁與線路形成。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: ABF is conductive copper foil. First check whether evidence for identify abf function actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: ABF provides interlayer insulation and a routing foundation; copper conducts.

Misinterpretation to reject: ABF is conductive copper foil. First check whether evidence for control seed and plating actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Seed continuity and local current distribution govern via-wall and trace formation.

guides.title: 嵌入式互連橋整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Embedded interconnect-bridge integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「比較局部與全面中介層」建立判讀邊界。局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare local and full interposers to define the interpretation boundary. A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較局部與全面中介層：觀察焦點：畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜追蹤回流與供電：觀察焦點：按所研究世代畫獨立供電路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付局部橋方案：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出相較完整中介層的兩項限制。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare local and full interposers: Observation focus: Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Trace returns and power: Observation focus: Draw separate power paths for the generation studied. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver bridge proposal: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: State two limitations relative to a full interposer. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「追蹤回流與供電」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付局部橋方案：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace returns and power: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver bridge proposal: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：矽橋等於覆蓋整包的矽中介層。本步先檢查「比較局部與全面中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：矽橋等於覆蓋整包的矽中介層。本步先檢查「追蹤回流與供電」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到資料經橋不代表全部供電也走同一路徑。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A silicon bridge equals a full-package silicon interposer. First check whether evidence for compare local and full interposers actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.

Misinterpretation to reject: A silicon bridge equals a full-package silicon interposer. First check whether evidence for trace returns and power actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Data crossing a bridge does not imply all power follows that route.

guides.concept: 先用「定義端到端參考面」建立判讀邊界。驅動器、焊墊、封裝與接收器都屬通道環境。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define end-to-end planes to define the interpretation boundary. Driver, pads, package and receiver all belong to the channel environment. 觀察站 3｜提交通道接受範圍：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列出尚未包含的封裝轉接。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define end-to-end planes: Observation focus: Mark start/end planes of measurement and model. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Check near/far crosstalk: Observation focus: Keep spacing fixed and vary parallel length. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver channel acceptance range: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List package transitions not yet included. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立熱源地圖：觀察焦點：用相同總功率畫均勻及集中兩種熱源，比較最高溫度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜校正溫度量測：觀察焦點：以獨立溫度感測點驗證一個 IR 區域。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付界面放行資料：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：為熱、機械與材料資料各列一項尚未解決的不確定度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build a heat-source map: Observation focus: Draw uniform and concentrated sources with equal power and compare peak temperature. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Calibrate temperature measurement: Observation focus: Validate one IR region with an independent temperature sensor. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver interface release evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List one unresolved uncertainty each in thermal, mechanical and material data. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「校正溫度量測」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付界面放行資料：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Calibrate temperature measurement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver interface release evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：熱導率最高的材料一定有最低組裝熱阻。本步先檢查「建立熱源地圖」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到面平均功率會掩蓋局部高熱通量，散熱蓋需把局部熱量展開。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：熱導率最高的材料一定有最低組裝熱阻。本步先檢查「校正溫度量測」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到紅外表觀溫度受放射率影響，金屬反射可造成假熱點或假冷點。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: The highest-conductivity material always gives the lowest assembled resistance. First check whether evidence for build a heat-source map actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Area-average power hides local heat flux; the lid must spread localized heat.

Misinterpretation to reject: The highest-conductivity material always gives the lowest assembled resistance. First check whether evidence for calibrate temperature measurement actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Infrared apparent temperature depends on emissivity; metal reflections can create false hot or cold…

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define heat-flux distribution to define the interpretation boundary. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.

觀察站 2｜驗證溫度場：觀察焦點：比較兩種熱點形狀，保持總熱量及流量相同。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜提交系統權衡：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：交付正常與堵塞兩工況，清楚區分假設及實測資料。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define heat-flux distribution: Observation focus: Place the same hotspot near inlet and outlet and compare. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Validate temperature fields: Observation focus: Compare two hotspot shapes at identical total heat and flow. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Submit a system tradeoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Deliver normal and blocked conditions, separating assumptions from measured data. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「驗證溫度場」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交系統權衡：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Validate temperature fields: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Submit a system tradeoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「定義熱通量分布」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到熱點位置比平均功率更能決定通道需求，上游與下游溫差也不可忽略。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「驗證溫度場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到流體出口平均溫度不能代表晶片峰值，需把固體導熱和流體對流連接。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for define heat-flux distribution actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Hotspot locations can govern channel needs more strongly than average power; upstream-downstream gradients matter.

Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for validate temperature fields actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mean outlet temperature is not peak die temperature; couple solid conduction to fluid convection.

guides.concept: 先用「定義氣密邊界」建立判讀邊界。腔體、蓋板與穿通件共同形成密封邊界。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define hermetic boundary to define the interpretation boundary. Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義氣密邊界：觀察焦點：逐一標出焊縫及電氣穿越處。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜先辨粗漏：觀察焦點：列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜建立氣密證據鏈：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：讓同學重算一份漏率報告。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define hermetic boundary: Observation focus: Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Screen gross leaks first: Observation focus: List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Build hermetic evidence chain: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Have a peer reconstruct one leak report. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「先辨粗漏」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

Build a controlled comparison for Screen gross leaks first: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Build hermetic evidence chain: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：氦細漏合格即可省略粗漏檢查。本步先檢查「定義氣密邊界」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到腔體、蓋板與穿通件共同形成密封邊界。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：氦細漏合格即可省略粗漏檢查。本步先檢查「先辨粗漏」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到大漏可能讓示蹤氣體在量測前流失，導致細漏假陰性。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for define hermetic boundary actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal.

Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for screen gross leaks first actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Connect device to vacuum need: Observation focus: List losses that Q alone cannot distinguish. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Separate bulk and interface resistance: Observation focus: Separate bond bulk and both interfaces into three terms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Define bond acceptance: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Plan an investigation for high strength but abnormal thermal resistance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：銀燒結一定完全無孔隙。本步先檢查「辨識固態燒結」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到顆粒間形成頸部及緻密化，不等同焊料液相凝固。所指出的物理限制。

guides.title: 陶瓷直接覆銅基板：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Direct-bonded-copper ceramic substrates: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識 DBC 結構」建立判讀邊界。陶瓷提供電氣隔離，銅層提供導電與橫向熱擴散。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify DBC structure to define the interpretation boundary. Ceramic provides isolation; copper provides conduction and lateral heat spreading. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識 DBC 結構：觀察焦點：畫銅陶瓷銅截面並標功能。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜驗算厚度熱阻：觀察焦點：重算 0.63 mm 算例並加倍厚度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付基板選型：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：對候選基板列出適用與不可外推條件。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify DBC structure: Observation focus: Draw a copper-ceramic-copper section and label functions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Calculate thickness resistance: Observation focus: Recalculate the 0.63 mm example at double thickness. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver substrate selection: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List validity and non-extrapolation conditions for each candidate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「驗算厚度熱阻」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付基板選型：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Calculate thickness resistance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver substrate selection: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「辨識 DBC 結構」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到陶瓷提供電氣隔離，銅層提供導電與橫向熱擴散。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「驗算厚度熱阻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到增加陶瓷厚度改善某些電氣邊界，卻增加一維熱阻。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism. First check whether evidence for identify dbc structure actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Ceramic provides isolation; copper provides conduction and lateral heat spreading.

Misinterpretation to reject: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism. First check whether evidence for calculate thickness resistance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Thicker ceramic can improve some electrical margins while increasing 1D thermal resistance.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義服役溫度史」建立判讀邊界。幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define service thermal history to define the interpretation boundary. Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義服役溫度史：觀察焦點：列完整時間軸而非只寫高低溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜定位首發失效：觀察焦點：結合分段測試與影像縮小位置。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出資料能支持與不能支持的壽命主張。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define service thermal history: Observation focus: Record a full timeline, not only extremes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Locate first failure: Observation focus: Combine segmented testing and imaging to localize. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: State which life claims the data support and do not support. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「定位首發失效」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Locate first failure: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定義服役溫度史」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定位首發失效」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到串聯菊鏈只指出某段異常，不能直接識別每個焊點。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for define service thermal history actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage.

Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for locate first failure actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A daisy chain identifies a faulty segment, not automatically the individual joint.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：有效折射率與群折射率相同。本步先檢查「畫出 SOI 截面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到矽核心、埋氧與上包覆共同決定模態，不只核心寬度。所指出的物理限制。

guides.titleEn: Subwavelength-grating waveguides: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義週期方向」建立判讀邊界。週期必須相對傳播方向與偏振定義。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define periodic direction to define the interpretation boundary. Period must be defined relative to propagation and polarization. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義週期方向：觀察焦點：畫單胞、週期與光傳播向量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜設計漸變轉接：觀察焦點：比較突變與漸變填充比轉接。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付 SWG 模型：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：指出有效介質與全波結果差異最大的點。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define periodic direction: Observation focus: Draw unit cell, period and propagation vector. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Design gradual transitions: Observation focus: Compare abrupt and tapered fill-factor transitions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver SWG model: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Identify the largest effective-medium/full-wave discrepancy. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設計漸變轉接」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付 SWG 模型：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Design gradual transitions: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver SWG model: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：只要週期小於自由空間波長就沒有 Bragg 效應。本步先檢查「定義週期方向」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到週期必須相對傳播方向與偏振定義。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：只要週期小於自由空間波長就沒有 Bragg 效應。本步先檢查「設計漸變轉接」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到傳統波導到 SWG 的模態不匹配會造成額外損耗。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Any period below free-space wavelength avoids Bragg effects. First check whether evidence for define periodic direction actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Period must be defined relative to propagation and polarization.

Misinterpretation to reject: Any period below free-space wavelength avoids Bragg effects. First check whether evidence for design gradual transitions actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode mismatch between conventional and SWG guides adds loss.

guides.title: 光柵耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Grating-coupler design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「設定光纖與偏振」建立判讀邊界。耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Specify fiber and polarization to define the interpretation boundary. The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜設定光纖與偏振：觀察焦點：記錄模場直徑及偏振定義。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜使用漸變光柵：觀察焦點：將目標包絡連到每段散射變化。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合容差：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：交付峰值、頻寬與位置容差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Specify fiber and polarization: Observation focus: Record mode-field diameter and polarization. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Use apodization: Observation focus: Relate target envelope to segment scattering. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupling tolerances: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Deliver peak efficiency, bandwidth and positional tolerance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「使用漸變光柵」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合容差：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Use apodization: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupling tolerances: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：光柵向上輻射效率就是光纖耦合效率。本步先檢查「設定光纖與偏振」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：光柵向上輻射效率就是光纖耦合效率。本步先檢查「使用漸變光柵」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到漸變散射可塑形出射場，但新增製造容差與最小特徵限制。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Upward radiation efficiency equals fiber coupling efficiency. First check whether evidence for specify fiber and polarization actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam.

Misinterpretation to reject: Upward radiation efficiency equals fiber coupling efficiency. First check whether evidence for use apodization actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Apodized scattering shapes output fields but adds tolerance and feature constraints.

guides.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Edge-coupler design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「比較晶片與光纖模場」建立判讀邊界。模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare chip and fiber modes to define the interpretation boundary. Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較晶片與光纖模場：觀察焦點：畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建立橫向容差：觀察焦點：重算 1 μm 偏移的 1.09 dB 例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：把模場半徑與直徑寫成兩個不同欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare chip and fiber modes: Observation focus: Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Build lateral tolerance: Observation focus: Recalculate 1.09 dB loss at 1 μm offset. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Record mode radius and diameter as separate fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立橫向容差」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build lateral tolerance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「比較晶片與光纖模場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「建立橫向容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到較大模場可增加偏移容忍，但也改變封裝尺寸需求。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for compare chip and fiber modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.

Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for build lateral tolerance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Larger modes tolerate offset but alter package requirements.

guides.title: 光纖陣列主動對準：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Active alignment of fiber arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義光功率參考面：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define optical power reference planes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義光功率參考面：模型與設計：使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
觀察站 2｜設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計：以一強一弱通道比較總和最大與最差通道最大兩解。
觀察站 3｜交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別：重複卸載重裝並比較每通道分布，不只報一次最佳值。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define optical power reference planes: model and design: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
Observation station 2 | Set an array objective: model and design: Compare maximum sum and maximum worst-channel solutions for unequal channels.
Observation station 3 | Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis: Repeat unload/reload and compare channel distributions, not one best result.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Set an array objective: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「總功率最大即每通道都最佳」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Maximum total power means every channel is optimum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 偏振分光旋轉器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Polarization splitter-rotators: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義偏振端口：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。TE/TM 標籤以波導主電場和傳播軸定義，不能直接沿用光纖接頭的上下方向。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define polarization-resolved ports: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. TE/TM labels depend on waveguide field and propagation axes, not simply connector orientation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義偏振端口：模型與設計：畫座標及每個端口允許的模式，核對注入模式名稱。
觀察站 2｜量測偏振串擾：模型與設計：在兩端口分別量 TE/TM，形成四項功率矩陣。
觀察站 3｜交付模式可追溯資料：量測與判別：用保存的多模 S 參數重建兩種入射偏振測試。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define polarization-resolved ports: model and design: Draw coordinates and supported modes at each port and check excitation labels.
Observation station 2 | Measure polarization crosstalk: model and design: Measure TE/TM at both outputs to form a four-entry power matrix.
Observation station 3 | Deliver mode-traceable data: measurement and diagnosis: Reconstruct both input-polarization tests from saved multimode S-parameters.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測偏振串擾：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付模式可追溯資料：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure polarization crosstalk: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver mode-traceable data: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「TE 就是任何照片中的水平方向」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「只量一個端口就能取得完整偏振矩陣」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "TE always means horizontal in a photograph" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "One port yields a complete polarization matrix" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 多模干涉分光器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Multimode-interference splitters: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立模態疊加：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。多模區內不同傳播常數累積相位差，在特定長度重建一個或多個像。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Build a modal superposition: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Modes with different propagation constants accumulate phase differences and recreate one or more images at selected lengths. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立模態疊加：模型與設計：畫至少三個模態的相位演進，檢查輸出位置。
觀察站 2｜量測不平衡：模型與設計：同時畫總傳輸與兩路比值，解讀 0.193 dB 範例。
觀察站 3｜驗證電路層重建：量測與判別：重建 MMI 頻譜並比對兩輸出複數響應及延遲。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build a modal superposition: model and design: Plot phase evolution of at least three modes and inspect image positions.
Observation station 2 | Measure imbalance: model and design: Plot total transmission and output ratio together and interpret the 0.193 dB example.
Observation station 3 | Verify circuit-level reconstruction: measurement and diagnosis: Reconstruct spectra and compare complex outputs and delay.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測不平衡：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「驗證電路層重建：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure imbalance: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Verify circuit-level reconstruction: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「MMI 就是把光當水平均分岔」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「平衡良好就代表損耗低」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "An MMI simply splits light like a fluid junction" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Good balance implies low loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.titleEn: Directional-coupler fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義波導與間隙：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。耦合由倏逝場重疊決定，間隙是側壁之間距離而非中心距離。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define guides and gap: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Coupling follows evanescent-field overlap; gap means sidewall spacing, not center spacing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義波導與間隙：模型與設計：在截面圖分開寬度、中心距和側壁間距。
觀察站 2｜納入接近與離開區：模型與設計：比較只含直段與含 S 彎的模態傳輸。
觀察站 3｜交付有效模型範圍：量測與判別：在模型邊界重建場解並檢查反射、功率和相位。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define guides and gap: model and design: Mark width, center spacing and sidewall gap separately.
Observation station 2 | Include approach and departure sections: model and design: Compare straight-only transfer with the full S-bend geometry.
Observation station 3 | Deliver model validity bounds: measurement and diagnosis: Reconstruct field solutions at model bounds and check reflection, power and phase.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「納入接近與離開區：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付有效模型範圍：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Include approach and departure sections: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver model validity bounds: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「中心距和間隙可以互換使用」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「只有平行直段才會產生耦合」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Center spacing and gap are interchangeable" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Only the parallel straight section couples" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 馬赫曾德爾調變器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Mach-Zehnder modulators: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義兩臂與端口：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。輸出是兩臂複數電場相加，能量會分配至互補端口；不能只加功率。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define arms and ports: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Output adds complex arm fields and distributes energy to complementary ports; powers alone cannot describe it. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義兩臂與端口：模型與設計：以零相位與 π 相位畫兩端口功率並核對守恆。
觀察站 2｜分析 RF 與光速度：模型與設計：比較不同長度的電光頻率響應及延遲。
觀察站 3｜交付偏壓相依模型：量測與判別：用獨立偏壓點驗證模型預測，而非只重播擬合資料。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define arms and ports: model and design: Plot both-port powers at zero and π phase and check conservation.
Observation station 2 | Analyze RF and optical velocities: model and design: Compare electro-optic frequency response and delay for different lengths.
Observation station 3 | Deliver a bias-dependent model: measurement and diagnosis: Validate at independent bias points rather than replaying fitted data.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分析 RF 與光速度：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付偏壓相依模型：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Analyze RF and optical velocities: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a bias-dependent model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「兩臂功率相加就能預測干涉」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「直流效率最高的長電極必定最高速」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Adding arm powers predicts interference" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "The most efficient long DC electrode is always fastest" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「建立回程相位：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。共振要求回程相位為整數 2π，幾何周長與有效折射率共同決定位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Establish round-trip phase: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Resonance requires integer-2π round-trip phase, set jointly by circumference and effective index. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立回程相位：模型與設計：比較加長環與增加有效折射率造成的共振移動。
觀察站 2｜選擇調變工作點：模型與設計：在固定雷射波長比較三個偏壓位置的動態響應。
觀察站 3｜交付頻譜與調變證據：量測與判別：以獨立溫度和輸入功率條件檢驗模型外推。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Establish round-trip phase: model and design: Compare resonance shifts from longer circumference and higher effective index.
Observation station 2 | Choose a modulation operating point: model and design: Compare dynamic response at three bias positions with fixed laser wavelength.
Observation station 3 | Deliver spectral and modulation evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Test predictions at independent temperature and input-power conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「選擇調變工作點：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付頻譜與調變證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Choose a modulation operating point: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver spectral and modulation evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「只要半徑相同共振波長一定相同」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「共振最深點一定是最高線性調變效率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Equal radii guarantee equal resonance wavelengths" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "The deepest point always maximizes linear modulation efficiency" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
