guides.title: 鍺矽雪崩光偵測器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Germanium-silicon avalanche photodetectors: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「劃分吸收與乘增區：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。Ge 可負責長波長吸收，Si 乘增區提供合適高場；兩區電場需求不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate absorption and multiplication regions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Ge can absorb long-wavelength light while Si supplies multiplication; their field requirements differ. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜劃分吸收與乘增區：模型與設計：畫材料、光生成與高場位置，核對載子走向。
觀察站 2｜建立完整噪聲預算：模型與設計：在相同噪聲頻寬比較低增益和高增益的總 SNR。
觀察站 3｜交付接收器適用性：量測與判別：在同一資料速率與誤碼定義下比較數個增益工作點。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate absorption and multiplication regions: model and design: Map materials, photogeneration and high field and check carrier travel.
Observation station 2 | Build a full noise budget: model and design: Compare total SNR at low/high gain using the same noise bandwidth.
Observation station 3 | Deliver receiver suitability evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare gain operating points at common data rate and error definition.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立完整噪聲預算：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付接收器適用性：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build a full noise budget: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver receiver suitability evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「吸收與乘增必須在同一材料同一位置」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「信號增加十倍就表示 SNR 增加十倍」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Absorption and multiplication must occur at one material/location" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Tenfold signal always means tenfold SNR" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define heater and optical regions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Heater placement sets heat-flow paths, while metal near a guide can increase optical absorption. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義加熱與光學區：模型與設計：在截面同時標電流、熱流和光模態。

觀察站 3｜交付控制模型：量測與判別：以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define heater and optical regions: model and design: Mark current, heat flow and optical mode on one cross-section.
Observation station 2 | Calculate a lumped time constant: model and design: Recalculate 2.00 ms and check the 63.2% step-response time.
Observation station 3 | Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「求集總時間常數：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付控制模型：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Calculate a lumped time constant: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「加熱器越靠近光芯只有好處」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「時間常數等於達到完全穩態的時間」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。

The incorrect inference "The time constant is the time to full steady state" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define junction and reverse bias: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Reverse bias widens depletion and changes free carriers overlapping the mode, rather than injecting many minority carriers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.

觀察站 2｜界定串聯電阻：模型與設計：用等效電路標出源、接觸與接面，檢查去嵌位置。
觀察站 3｜交付一致偏壓模型：量測與判別：用同一器件資料集預測 MZI 或微環響應並留獨立驗證點。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define junction and reverse bias: model and design: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion.
Observation station 2 | Define series resistance: model and design: Map source, contacts and junction in the equivalent circuit and check de-embedding planes.
Observation station 3 | Deliver a consistent bias model: measurement and diagnosis: Predict MZI/ring response from one consistent dataset and reserve independent validation points.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「界定串聯電阻：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付一致偏壓模型：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Define series resistance: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a consistent bias model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

錯誤推論「50 Ω 儀器介面代表元件內部電阻一定 50 Ω」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。

pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Depletion modulation is forward carrier injection" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「晶軸與偏振：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Crystal axes and polarization: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶軸與偏振：模型與設計：旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
觀察站 2｜光電速度匹配：模型與設計：從射頻相位斜率與光群延遲分別萃取兩個速度，列出頻率相依性。
觀察站 3｜封裝交接：量測與判別：在相同校正面比較裸晶與封裝曲線，保存去嵌入檔與偏壓條件。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Crystal axes and polarization: model and design: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
Observation station 2 | Velocity matching: model and design: Extract velocities independently from RF phase slope and optical group delay, including frequency dependence.
Observation station 3 | Package handoff: measurement and diagnosis: Compare bare-die and packaged curves at matched calibration planes and retain de-embedding files and bias conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「光電速度匹配：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「封裝交接：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Velocity matching: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Package handoff: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「混合與異質整合：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。對接已製成雷射與先接合材料再製作元件，是不同的流程與良率邊界。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Hybrid versus heterogeneous integration: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Attaching a completed laser and bonding material before device fabrication have different process and yield boundaries. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜混合與異質整合：模型與設計：繪出兩條流程並標示可以做 known-good-die 檢查的位置。
觀察站 2｜電流展布：模型與設計：將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
觀察站 3｜量產可測試性：量測與判別：設計封裝前後同參考面的測試矩陣，區分新失效與原有裸晶缺陷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Hybrid versus heterogeneous integration: model and design: Draw both flows and mark where known-good-die screening is possible.
Observation station 2 | Current spreading: model and design: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.
Observation station 3 | Production testability: measurement and diagnosis: Design pre/post-package tests at matched planes to separate new failures from pre-existing die defects.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

以「量產可測試性：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Current spreading: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Production testability: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Donor-coupon boundary: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Donor-coupon boundary: model and design: Draw conceptual device, tether and release-layer sections and mark tests completed before release.
Observation station 2 | Vertical and lateral coupling: model and design: Plot sensitivity on three error axes and compare coupled power with scattering images rather than optimizing one axis alone.
Observation station 3 | Traceability coding: measurement and diagnosis: Link donor position, screening result, stamp batch and target position, then perform a reverse trace.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Dots versus wells: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Three-dimensional confinement changes the density of states; dots do not automatically remove nonradiative recombination. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜量子點與量子井：模型與設計：比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Dots versus wells: model and design: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.
Observation station 2 | Carrier capture: model and design: Compare frequency response and bias curves to identify where one-lifetime fitting fails.
Observation station 3 | System integration acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Compare on-chip dot and external lasers at equal received-power targets, including service and cooling.

guides.titleEn: Silicon-photonic frequency combs: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「矽與氮化矽：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。矽光子生態含不同材料；Si 與 SiN 的吸收、非線性與熱限制不能混用。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Silicon versus silicon nitride: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. The silicon-photonics ecosystem includes distinct materials; Si and SiN absorption, nonlinearity and thermal limits are not interchangeable. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜矽與氮化矽：模型與設計：建立兩材料在選定波段的非線性與損失表，未知值不猜填。
觀察站 2｜泵浦失諧：模型與設計：比較正反向掃描的透射、梳功率與射頻雜訊。
觀察站 3｜應用驗收：量測與判別：為一個選定用途列最差梳齒驗收，不以總頻寬取代全部指標。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Silicon versus silicon nitride: model and design: Build material tables for the chosen band and leave unmeasured values unresolved.
Observation station 2 | Pump detuning: model and design: Compare transmission, comb power and RF noise on forward/reverse scans.
Observation station 3 | Application acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Define worst-line acceptance for one application rather than replacing all metrics with total span.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「泵浦失諧：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「應用驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Pump detuning: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Application acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：等間距光譜即可證明全部梳齒相干。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Equally spaced spectra alone prove full comb coherence. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「自發與受激：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。自發四波混頻可產生相關光子對；經典增益或明亮光譜本身不是量子證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Spontaneous four-wave mixing can create correlated pairs; classical gain or bright spectra alone are not quantum evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜自發與受激：模型與設計：將平均功率、單光子計數與符合計數分為三種不同觀察。
觀察站 2｜符合視窗：模型與設計：比較三種視窗的原始符合、旁窗背景及淨符合。
觀察站 3｜可擴展性證據：量測與判別：比較兩顆獨立源的干涉與跨晶片重複性，列尚未驗證的整合項。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design: Separate mean power, singles and coincidences as three different observations.
Observation station 2 | Coincidence window: model and design: Compare raw, side-window background and net coincidences for three windows.
Observation station 3 | Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare interference from two independent sources and cross-chip repeatability, listing unverified integration items.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「符合視窗：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可擴展性證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Coincidence window: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：觀測符合率一定等於光子對產生率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.title: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Thermomechanical analysis of photonic packages: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「模型分區：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Model partition: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜模型分區：模型與設計：畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。
觀察站 2｜光彈與幾何：模型與設計：分別關閉幾何及材料項作敏感度比較，避免重複計入。
觀察站 3｜模型驗收：量測與判別：保留一組不同功耗及邊界條件資料作盲驗證，報告殘差位置。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Model partition: model and design: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.
Observation station 2 | Photoelasticity and geometry: model and design: Toggle geometric and material terms separately in sensitivity analysis to avoid double counting.
Observation station 3 | Model acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Withhold a different power/boundary dataset for blind validation and map residuals.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「光彈與幾何：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「模型驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Photoelasticity and geometry: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Model acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Free expansion equals constrained-package stress. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「受控量定義：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。功率、共振波長與相位不是同一受控量，鎖功率可能鎖在錯誤光譜位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Controlled quantity: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Power, resonance wavelength and phase differ; a power lock can select the wrong spectral point. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜受控量定義：模型與設計：在頻譜上標出工作點和誤差信號零點，列出可能的多解。
觀察站 2｜控制延遲：模型與設計：把延遲加入頻率模型，記錄階躍超越與振盪。
觀察站 3｜重新校準：量測與判別：建立版本化校正與安全回復設定，以未參與擬合的負載驗證。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Controlled quantity: model and design: Mark operating point and error-signal zeros and list ambiguous solutions.
Observation station 2 | Control delay: model and design: Include delay in the frequency model and record overshoot/oscillation.
Observation station 3 | Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis: Version calibration and fallback settings; validate on an unfitted load pattern.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「控制延遲：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「重新校準：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Control delay: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero error proves the source and path are healthy. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Graph model: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Nodes, edges and shared resources define a single-fault domain; not every fault is merely a broken edge. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.

觀察站 3｜恢復證據：量測與判別：交付每個單故障的路徑、裕度、容量與未涵蓋故障列表。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Graph model: model and design: Tag failures separately for sources, couplers, controllers and cooling.
Observation station 2 | Fault detection: model and design: Place independent monitors and compare observation vectors across faults.
Observation station 3 | Restoration evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver path, margin and capacity for each single fault plus explicit uncovered cases.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Fault detection: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Restoration evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.concept: 先用「應力與應變：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。應力單位為 Pa，應變無量綱；光彈係數的定義決定輸入哪一個量。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Stress and strain: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Stress is measured in Pa and strain is dimensionless; coefficient definition determines the input quantity. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜應力與應變：模型與設計：逐項檢查係數單位，禁止把 strain-optic 係數直接乘 Pa。
觀察站 2｜雙折射：模型與設計：用偏振分辨或干涉量測，分離振幅不平衡和相位延遲。
觀察站 3｜獨立驗證：量測與判別：保留獨立應變或形貌量測及未擬合的負載，用以驗證預測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Stress and strain: model and design: Audit units and never multiply a strain-optic coefficient directly by Pa.
Observation station 2 | Birefringence: model and design: Use polarization-resolved or interferometric measurements to separate amplitude imbalance and retardance.
Observation station 3 | Independent validation: measurement and diagnosis: Withhold independent strain/profile data and an unfitted load for validation.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「雙折射：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「獨立驗證：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Birefringence: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Independent validation: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：應力 Pa 與無量綱應變可以直接互換。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Scope definition: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. EMC testing depends on equipment use and applicable standards, not the optical-module label. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜範圍界定：模型與設計：建立用途、端口、環境與標準版本表，由合格實驗室確認適用性。
觀察站 2｜外殼與縫隙：模型與設計：逐一改變接縫連接與出口處理，分離來源降低和路徑阻斷。
觀察站 3｜修改回歸：量測與判別：同時比較發射、溫度、BER與可維修性，避免以單一指標放行。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Scope definition: model and design: Document use, ports, environment and standard revision for qualified applicability review.
Observation station 2 | Housing and seams: model and design: Change seam/exit treatment individually to separate source reduction from path interruption.
Observation station 3 | Modification regression: measurement and diagnosis: Compare emissions, temperature, BER and serviceability instead of one metric.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「外殼與縫隙：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「修改回歸：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Housing and seams: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Modification regression: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：光纖傳資料就完全沒有電磁發射。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.concept: 先用「平台與證據：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。SoIC 公開架構說明垂直晶粒整合，不能由品牌名稱推出未公布的清洗或接合配方。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Platform and evidence: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. The public SoIC architecture describes vertical integration, not undisclosed cleaning or bonding recipes. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜平台與證據：模型與設計：建立公開來源與未知參數表，將設計假設分開記錄。

evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。iSiPP200 與 iSiPP300 是不同平台，晶圓直徑不是唯一差異，也不能假設元件庫可直接互換。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Platform and wafer size: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 are distinct platforms; diameter is not their only difference and libraries are not interchangeable. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計：將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。
觀察站 2｜轉印材料：模型與設計：比較加入元件前後的損耗、相位和電性能，避免只看功能是否出現。
觀察站 3｜設計釋出：量測與判別：交付可追溯 manifest、已知限制和回歸結果，不宣稱公開文件等於完整流片許可。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Platform and wafer size: model and design: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits.
Observation station 2 | Transfer-printed materials: model and design: Compare loss, phase and electrical behavior before/after integration, not merely function presence.
Observation station 3 | Design release: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a traceable manifest, known limits and regression results; public documentation is not fabrication authorization.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「轉印材料：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「設計釋出：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transfer-printed materials: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Design release: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
